changeSet.author: Core
changeSet.sql: create or alter view [dbo].[OrganizationDetail] as select o.ID, o.Name, o.Accepted, o.AcceptedBy, o.DateAccepted, o.AdministratorEmail, r.FirstName + ' ' + r.LastName as AcceptedByName, o.OrganizationTypeID from Organization o left join reporting.Global_Resource r on r.ResourceID = o.AcceptedBy where o.[State] = 1
